description:
Meet DecepticonX

DecepticonX — we love technology, AI, and turning ideas into products. For NASA Space Apps, we are exploring “Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map”, combining AI, NASA data, maps, and UI/UX.

What we bring:

AI/ML and full-stack development

GIS, maps, and data analysis

UI/UX, research, and prototyping

Why join ?
We want teammates who love to build, learn, and contribute. We welcome skills in space science, GIS, AI/ML, 3D, and design.

Ideas Beyond Boundaries.
